description: Source code for a command-line utility that performs encryption/decryption of firmware files using custom header cryptography, with command-line options for input/output files and decrypt/encrypt mode.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and options for the command-line utility.

methods.name: crypt_header
methods.description: Performs header encryption/decryption by substituting characters based on provided keys.

methods.name: crypt_file
methods.description: Reads input file, applies cryptographic transformation, and writes output file.

methods.name: check_params
methods.description: Validates that input and output filenames are specified.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program, handles command-line arguments and orchestrates the cryptographic process.
